clips.title: The story
paras: Dreamer's Rock is a secluded natural sanctuary tucked deep within the Wailing Caverns past the Screaming Gully. Here lies the sleeping night elf druid Naralex, whose noble effort to revive the Barrens has instead birthed a living nightmare. It serves as both a sacred barrow chamber and the epicenter of the corruption mutating the surrounding subterranean ecosystem.

Located in the heart of the Wailing Caverns, Dreamer's Rock functions much like an improvised barrow den. Here, the night elf druid Naralex entered a deep trance to tap the underground springs and channel the Emerald Dream into the arid soil of the Barrens. Instead of bringing life, his connection was seized by dark forces. The nightmare twisting his thoughts now spills physically into this chamber, twisting the local wildlife, turning his followers into the venomous Druids of the Fang, and manifesting terrifying aberrations into the waking world.
